update.title: Update {{label}} to the newest default?
update.body: You haven't edited this, so Paperclip will replace it with the newer shipped version. Nothing you customized is affected, and your adapter credentials and settings are not touched.

reset.title: Reset {{label}} to the shipped default?
reset.body: This replaces your edited version with Paperclip's current default. Your edits can't be recovered. Adapter credentials and settings are not touched.

recreate.title: Recreate {{label}}?
recreate.body: This resource is missing. Paperclip will recreate it from the shipped default. Adapter credentials and settings are not touched.

drift.modified: You've edited this. Your changes are kept until you reset.
drift.missing: Not materialized yet — recreate it from the shipped default.

adapter.pendingApproval: Waiting on board hire approval before this coach can run.
adapter.needsSetup: Pick an adapter this coach can run on.
adapter.label: Adapter

routine.label: Routine
routine.enabledDetail: The weekly schedule is enabled and can create background work.
routine.disabledDetail: Nothing runs until you enable the weekly schedule — it costs zero tokens by default.

runOnce.title: Run Reflection Coach once?
runOnce.body: Paperclip will create one routine task now. This does not enable the weekly schedule or turn on background work.

disable.title: Disable the weekly schedule?
disable.body: Paperclip will stop future scheduled Reflection Coach runs. Manual Run once remains available.

enable.title: Enable the weekly schedule?
enable.body: Paperclip will allow Reflection Coach to create routine tasks on the weekly schedule. It can spend tokens when those tasks run.

proposal.label: Proposal
proposal.detail: A proposed Reflection Coach update is waiting for review.
